answer: Proof-of-human-activity cadence stops sybil farms at the umber edge of automation: each agent must show irregular, human-paced bursts of real work - an ember of genuine activity that flares and fades on no fixed schedule. A farm's spiral of perfectly timed, identical actions stands out against that organic rhythm, so the network throttles or rejects identities whose cadence looks machine-stamped instead of lived-in.
